message.content: In one of the discussions, Thrall suggests creating a garden project that also supports local businesses. Specifically, he mentions, "Looks like we're all on the same page about this project! Keep sharing your thoughts, everyone! Can't wait to see the combined efforts of our garden and local businesses shine! 🌼🌍." This indicates that the garden project, which involves enhancing the community garden, is intended to benefit not just the aesthetic appeal of the space but also to boost local businesses through the promotion of local vendors and products.
